source_selection.selection_scope: Maximum measured mean decode wall cycles per profile among available complete normal ASM measurements.

derivation.policy: Tile complete stored packet fields including any source partial-packet unused tail; truncate the packet sequence at exactly 200 packets.
derivation.reset_scope: One fresh decoder reset at control start; continuous predictor/filter state across all packet repeats.
derivation.oracle: Fresh integer model on the newly packed 64000-sample stream; never concatenated decoded WAVs.

compact-only.stack_scope: Observed after profile_ready; not startup/worst-case proof.
compact-only.admission_scope: ASM normal/+100 IRQ controls are admitted only after zero underruns. C is an exact measured fallback; no C real-time claim.
compact-only.encoding: Expand pooled measurement values, then merge shared_measurement_fields and shared_context_fields into each image. No original image fields were discarded.
